sv.title: Lugn börsöppning efter Nvidia-rapporten
sv.summary: Stockholmsbörsen inleder onsdagen med små rörelser efter tisdagskvällens Nvidiarapport. ABB, med exponering mot AI-industrin, stiger.

en.title: Calm stock market opening after Nvidia report
en.summary: The Stockholm stock exchange opens Wednesday with small movements after Tuesday evening's Nvidia report. ABB, which is exposed to the AI industry, is rising.
